name: openbb_crypto_price
description:
Daily price history for one cryptocurrency pair through the OpenBB Platform (obb.crypto.price.historical).
Returns: {symbol, data_points, start_date, end_date, prices: [{date, open, high, low, close, volume, ...}]}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (pair, upper-cased, e.g. BTCUSD, ETHUSD; default BTCUSD); start_date (YYYY-MM-DD; default 90 days ago); end_date (YYYY-MM-DD; default today); provider (fmp, polygon, tiingo or yfinance; default yfinance, no key).
Other sources: av_crypto_daily, yf_crypto_info, cg_coin_market_chart. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "ETHUSD", "start_date": "2026-01-01"}
